name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 04
name.en: 30MM Option parts set ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 04

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化！
description.en: “ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON” items are commercialized in the “30 MINUTES MISSIONS” series!

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、ガトリングガンを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場！
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," weapons including the Gatling gun are now available as optional parts sets!
• Weapons include "DF-GA-08 HU-BEN ", " DF-ET-09 TAI-YANG-SHOU ", " BML-G2/P17SPL-16 ", and " BML-G1/P20MLT-04".

description.ja: • 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.
